title: Replication code and data for: Participatory Science on the Farm — Shared Observational Effort is Lacking on Agricultural Lands
description:
Scripts, intermediate tables and derived county-level data that reproduce the analysis in Participatory Science on the Farm: Shared Observational Effort is Lacking on Agricultural Lands (Nicholas Gunner, Yu Jiang, Kaitlin Gold, Sara Emery & Terence Bates; Cornell AgriTech, Cornell University). Analysis code and data were produced by Nicholas Gunner; the article co-authors are listed as contributors.

Contents: (1) the 2023 county-level analysis of citizen-science observational disparity, 1 km observational coverage and the Observational Effort Index, built from a GBIF human-observation download (DOI 10.15468/dl.5h7by2), the USGS Annual NLCD 2023 land cover, NWS county boundaries and USDA ERS county socioeconomic data; (2) the Earth Engine scripts for the 1 km coverage map; (3) a self-contained GBIF Maps API × USGS Annual NLCD pipeline for the 2014–2024 disparity time series; (4) figure scripts; (5) the final county dataset for 3,108 CONUS counties (CSV and GeoJSON). Large raw inputs are not included; their DOIs, filters and retrieval dates are documented in data/DATA_SOURCES.md.

Code: MIT licence. Derived data and figures: CC BY 4.0.
